values.meaning: Window to use the empowered attack
values.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds
values.binNote: Wiki says the empowerment window is 5 seconds while bin BuffDuration is 6; recorded the wiki's stated value and flagged the discrepancy.

values.meaning: Cooldown reduction per damage instance from Wukong or clone
values.quote: {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy

mechanics.claim: Crushing Blow empowers the next basic attack with an uncancellable windup, bonus range, and bonus damage, then applies the armor reduction after the attack lands.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and then inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage attack resets Wukong's (and his clone's) basic attack timer, so other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.
mechanics.quote: Crushing Blow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Wukong's''' and his {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone's}} basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins counting down only after the empowered attack lands (or the window expires), not on cast.
The bonus damage portion is tagged as proc damage while the basic attack portion counts as both basic and spell damage; this affects on-hit interactions.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|basic attack}} portion of ''Crushing Blow'' is tagged as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, while the bonus damage portion is {{tip|proc damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Against structures and wards the attack still triggers but the armor reduction does not apply (irrelevant to a dummy fight but noted for completeness).
mechanics.quote: ''Crushing Blow'' triggers on {{tip|turret|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}} but the armor reduction is not applied.
